annotations.title: FEMA flood zone at a point

description: FEMA flood zone at a point: Flood hazard zone(s) intersecting a coordinate from FEMA's National Flood Hazard Layer (layer 28, free, no key): zone code, subtype, SFHA flag, static BFE. Source: FEMA NFHL. Not an official flood zone determination. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: mapped, in_sfha, zones[{zone, subtype, sfha, static_bfe_ft, dfirm_id}].
name: x420_geo_flood-zone
